business_problem: Docusign needed to extract and operationalize data trapped inside agreements for its Intelligent Agreement Management platform, but CPU-based inference and fragmented serving infrastructure made it hard to scale throughput while controlling latency and cloud cost.
solution_summary: Docusign standardized its agreement-AI stack on NVIDIA's inference platform so the same serving layer could support multiple agreement-understanding scenarios without bespoke deployment work. Triton Inference Server became the unified runtime for models that extract parties, terms, dates, and other agreement metadata, replacing framework-specific servers that were harder to manage at scale. As usage grew, Docusign migrated those models from on-premises CPU servers to Azure-based NVIDIA GPUs, then began compiling them with TensorRT and moving toward A100 Tensor Core GPUs to drive still lower latency. This architecture turned model serving into a reusable platform capability for Intelligent Agreement Management: documents and agreement text are processed by GPU-backed inference services, outputs are passed into IAM applications, and product teams can optimize throughput and cost centrally instead of scenario by scenario.

solution_components.name: NVIDIA Triton Inference Server
solution_components.role: Provides the unified inference layer Docusign uses across multiple AI frameworks and agreement scenarios.

solution_components.name: NVIDIA TensorRT
solution_components.role: Compiles models for lower-latency agreement inference in production.

solution_components.name: NVIDIA A100 Tensor Core GPUs
solution_components.role: Supply the GPU capacity Docusign is adopting on Azure for higher-throughput model serving.

solution_components.name: Microsoft Azure
solution_components.role: Hosts the cloud GPU environment that now runs Docusign's AI agreement services.

data_flow: Agreement documents enter Docusign IAM applications, where Triton-served models extract parties, terms, dates, and other metadata. TensorRT and Azure-hosted GPUs optimize the inference path, and the resulting structured data is fed back into Docusign's agreement-management workflows for review, insights, and action.
business_outcome: Docusign moved agreement AI into a reusable GPU-backed serving platform, accelerated its main scenarios several times over, and reduced the engineering burden of running many different AI models as the company scaled intelligent agreement management to a global customer base.
